description:
About Us

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing -- they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce -- where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

About the role

We are looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to keep our hiring process running smoothly for candidates, interviewers and recruiters across time zones. You will own interview scheduling for the global recruiting team and support both technical roles (engineering, product, data) and non-technical roles (sales, marketing, customer success, operations). You will work closely with our recruiters in Palo Alto and our sourcing team in Pakistan.

This role is fully remote from Pakistan and requires working Pacific Time hours so you can coordinate in real time with hiring managers, interviewers and candidates in the US.

What you will do

  • Schedule phone screens, interview loops, onsites and debriefs for candidates and interviewers across multiple time zones

  • Manage last-minute reschedules, interviewer swaps and calendar conflicts quickly and calmly

  • Keep candidate records, interview stages and feedback up to date in our applicant tracking system (Ashby)

  • Send interview confirmations, prep materials and follow-ups so every candidate knows what to expect

  • Follow up with interviewers to make sure feedback is submitted on time

  • Coordinate onsite logistics for our Palo Alto office, including room bookings, visitor access and travel when needed

  • Pull basic pipeline and scheduling reports for the recruiting team

  • Spot repeated friction in the process and suggest fixes, such as templates, scheduling rules or interviewer pools

  • Help with recruiting events and other team projects as they come up

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of experience in recruiting coordination, scheduling, executive assistance or a similar high-volume coordination role

  • Willingness and ability to work Pacific Time hours on a consistent basis

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with a friendly and professional tone in email and live conversation

  • Strong organization and attention to detail; you can juggle many calendars and requests without dropping any

  • Comfort with Google Workspace (Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Sheets) and Slack

  • Good judgment with confidential candidate and employee information

  • A service mindset toward candidates and interviewers, and the ability to stay calm when plans change

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting US-based or global recruiting teams

  • Experience using AI to automate workflow processes

  • Experience coordinating for both technical and non-technical hiring

  • Hands-on use of an applicant tracking system, especially Ashby, Greenhouse or Lever

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup

  • Familiarity with scheduling tools such as GoodTime, Calendly or Ashby scheduling

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: You know our hiring process, tools and interviewers, and you are scheduling interviews on your own.

  • First 90 days: You own scheduling for all open roles, interviews are booked quickly, and candidates and interviewers rarely need to chase anyone for details.

  • First 6 months: You have improved at least one part of our process, such as scheduling templates, interviewer pools or candidate communications.
